en: \rMarnie: You were amazing. And I did my best.
\rMagnolia: My, if it isn't \PN. Thank you again for you help in stopping the Darkest Day, but that doesn't mean I'll hold back in this battle.
\rMagnolia: I suppose I need to do more research on how to use Dynamax more effectively.
\rMagnolia: I suppose my research on using Dynamax paid off.
\rSonia: Hey \PN! I'm not much of a battler, but I'll show you how knowledge on Pokémon can give you an advantage in battle!
\rSonia: Phew! I gave that everything I had and used all my knowledge and still couldn't beat you. You're truly incredible!
\rSonia: Phew! I gave that everything I had and used all my knowledge and still barely won. You're truly incredible!
\rCissy: Ah, \PN. It's a shame I can't force you to use Water-type Pokémon here, but I'll still beat you.
\rCissy: Hmph. If only you'd been using Water-type Pokémon as well.
\rCissy: Told you so.
\bDanny: Hey, \PN. No need for a mountain trial this time, let's just battle!
\bDanny: Don't worry about it, I'll get better.
\bDanny: Don't worry about it, you'll get better.
\bRudy: Hi \PN. Don't think I'm holding back this time.
\bRudy: I'll battle you again when you're even better.
\rLuana: Oh my, it's \PN! Looks like you get to see our improved combinations.
\rLuana: There are still some surprises after all.
\bPaul: Oh, \PN. What am I doing here? To prove myself as the strongest trainer in the world, of course. Let's see how much we've both improved since last time.
\bPaul: I'd expect nothing less from you. Until next time.
\bPaul: Hmph. That wasn't on purpose, was it?
\bTrip: Heh, \PN. Can't wait to beat you properly again!
\bTrip: I'm not surprised. Until next time.
\bTrip: Hmph. Is that all?
\bDrake: Hey, \PN! Let's see what two champions can do.
\bDrake: It's always great to battle someone on my level.
\bGiovanni: \PN... Crushing my plans time and time again. Get ready for a world of pain!
\bGiovanni: Grr... I will have my revenge!
\bGiovanni: Hmm... All according to plan.
\bLance: We meet again, \PN. Thank you again for supporting me in my work for the Pokémon G-Men. I'm excited to battle you - as equals!
\bLance: That was a great battle! Looks like you've surpassed me.
\bLance: That was close, but you're not quite there yet.
\bSteven: Well \PN, I know how strong you are already. Let's battle!
\bSteven: I suppose you're the strongest there is!
\bSteven: I'll be the strongest there is next time.
\bWallace: How good to see you again, \PN. Surely you remember me this time. Well, even if you don't, my masterful performance will force you to!
\bWallace: Your masterful performance bedazzled me!
\bWallace: Don't you know, beauty contributes to strength?
\rCynthia: Ah, \PN. It's good to have the opportunity to battle you again - with no holds barred!
\rCynthia: That battle was too much fun!
\bAlder: Oh... \PN! Let's have a good fight.
\bAlder: Well done. Keep going forwards!
\bAlder: Another step further.
\rIris: Hey \PN! Let me show you how much I've improved since the last time we battled!
\rIris: Phew... I've gotta keep improving still!
\rIris: Phew... That was a tough battle!
\bAlain: Of all people I get to battle here, it's you, PN. I'm glad we get the chance to battle again.
\bAlain: As expected. Stand proud PN, you're strong.
\bAlain: Unlucky PN, don't underestimate me. Remember that I've beaten you before, even if it was a close battle back then.
\rDiantha: Oh, \PN! I've been hoping to battle you again and I'm glad we get the chance to do so here!
\rDiantha: Witnessing the noble spirits of you and your Pokémon in battle has really touched my heart...
\rDiantha: Oh, fantastic! My team was pretty cool, right? It's a bit embarrassing to show off, but I love to show their best sides!
\bGladion: Let's do this, \PN! I'm giving this everything I've got, so don't hold back.
\bGladion: That's the \PN I'd expect to battle. This is your victory.
\bGladion: That's the \PN I'd expect to battle. Took me a lot more than I thought I'd need to win!
\bKukui: Are you pumped, cousin? Let's have fun while giving it everything we've got!
\bKukui: Woo! Wonderful fight. Let's do it again someday when we've got time.
\bKukui: Woo! I couldn't have such a satisfying victory against anyone else!
\bLeon: Good to see you here, \PN. Ready for a Champion Time?
\bLeon: That truly was a Champion Time!
\bBrock: They will have a hard time inflicting any damage on us!
\bBrock: Let me show you my rock-hard willpower!
\bBrock: Well, I'll see you around!
\rMisty: I'll support you with all I got!
\rMisty: Woohoo! Can't wait to test out our new strength!
\rMisty: Bye!
\bLt. Surge: Let's join forces.
\bLt. Surge: I'll shock them into surrender!
\bLt. Surge: Dismissed.
\rErika: I'll do my best not to let you down!
\rErika: Oh my, how lovely!
\rErika: I'm afraid I might doze off.
\rSabrina: I had a vision of this moment.
\rSabrina: Let's witness the future with our own eyes!
\rSabrina: I've already foreseen it.
\rJanine: I'm the real deal!
\rJanine: Looks like I'm up!
\rJanine: See ya later!
\bBlaine: My fiery Pokémon will incinerate all challengers!
\bBlaine: Yeah, this sets my heart aflame!
\bBlaine: Until we meet again!
